title: 74HC595 Shift Register LED Bar Graph and Daisy-Chain Explorer
description: Given a sequence of data bits and clock pulses, demonstrate how the 74HC595's shift register bit order fills its eight outputs one pulse at a time, distinguish the effect of the Output Enable and Reset pins, and compare manually-clocked stepping to an automatic 555-driven clock.

author: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning Electronics
